title: Fractured Memories | ECHO//100 Episode 96
description:
Kavi hunts for a weapon within the collapsing ruins of his own reality. He discovers the origin of his journey is a trap built of his own history. Episode 96 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an original work of fiction created with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The void crumbles as a shard of the dead phone ignites with blinding, impossible white light.
scenes.caption: Blinding light erupts
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing in a dark void, staring at a glowing white phone fragment on the floor.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches for the glowing glass while the surrounding static screams, forcing memories to realign.
scenes.caption: Reality begins shifting
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi grabbing the shard, his hand vibrating with digital energy as the background reality tears apart.

scenes.text: The device shifts, its light forming a needle that spins wildly toward a point in time.
scenes.caption: A cosmic compass
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of the phone shard in Kavi's hand, projecting a holographic needle pointing toward a swirling temporal rift.

scenes.text: The compass pulls Kavi deep into the Memory Nexus, where failed timelines rot like discarded paper.
scenes.caption: Entering the nexus
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi walking through a surreal landscape of floating, broken clocks and half-formed cityscapes in the Memory Nexus.

scenes.text: Null’s erasure closes in, turning the horizon into jagged, empty lines of absolute black nothingness.
scenes.caption: Erasure approaches
scenes.image_prompt: Null, wearing Kavi's face, standing in the distance while the world behind him dissolves into black pixels.

scenes.text: The needle stops spinning, locking onto the person who handed Kavi the phone years ago.
scenes.caption: The source revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing before a shimmering mirror portal, his expression shifting from confusion to sudden, sharp realization.

scenes.text: Kavi expects a mentor or a ghost, but the path ends at a mirror image.
scenes.caption: A shocking connection
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching out toward a temporal distortion that shows the silhouette of a younger version of himself.

scenes.text: The younger self turns, holding the phone, eyes widening as he realizes who Kavi has become.
scenes.caption: The loop closes
scenes.image_prompt: Young Kavi in a smaller red hoodie holding the phone, looking directly at adult Kavi with absolute recognition.
